name: postcontrast-cascade

cpu.note: T23: T1-type brain candidates at calibrated sites a second, stage 1 over the speed sample's whole sessions (29,238 MR stacks, 4,207 candidates) in 1,221.5 s, model loading included, peak memory 9.78 GiB. pcs-speed's 5.51 had the student on 16 threads beside the 32 readers. The descriptor's default is 8 workers (cores 8), fewer than measured here
cpu.hardware: 32 worker processes reading slices, the student on torch's default threads, in the research container (64 cores of an AMD EPYC 9745 host, 256 GB), the archive over NFS 4.2, cold on the client; the served image nils-postcontrast (one image: torch 2.8.0 from its CUDA 12.8 wheels) on the CPU in float32, as the engine's apptainer runner runs it

gpu.note: T23: as on the CPU, 76.9 s, the card's memory 2,607 MiB above its start, peak memory 7.34 GiB; pcs-speed measured 42.27 a second on card 1 with the research environment. The descriptor's default is 8 workers (cores 8), fewer than measured here
gpu.hardware: 32 worker processes reading slices, in the research container (64 cores of an AMD EPYC 9745 host, 256 GB), the archive over NFS 4.2, cold on the client; card 1, an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB under the lease, shared with a staff process at 99 to 100 % use; the same served image, the student under bfloat16 autocast (--nv)

limits: Trained on the group's own data: a site model, never exported and never in a release (spec 10.6)
answers only at the four calibrated sites: iaid GE, iaid Philips, iaid Siemens, multiple_ms Philips (cohort as the archive folder, make); every other site is not sure (reason no-calibration)
stage 1 runs without model r1's ratio-pair tier; on production inputs (test B) the package keeps 99.55 % (D-dev) and 99.59 % (D-seal) of the frozen cascade's answers, every change to not sure
the header evidence is read from today's registry (rules, words, clock); round 1 read pack 0.15's rules answers; the effect is test B of pcs-grade
about 6 % of T1-type brain stacks are deferred to the full pipeline (postcontrast-full), whose pinned image is not built yet; until it is, a deferred stack stays not sure (reason deferred)
no registered label set yet (spec 10.3 is the label-sets slice); the student's training rows and targets are named by their sha256 until it is

Since nils-postcontrast 0.2.0 the fallback (postcontrast-full) says not sure, with the reason no-usable-volume or no-segmentation, for a deferred stack left with no image arm because it has no usable volume or no segmentation after the card, its retry and the CPU, where model r1 would answer from its header evidence alone, which no test compared with a reference (record 55 E3, 2026-10-14)
On the CPU alone, the package changed 1 of 2,003 scans' answers in its graded test A (pcs-grade, 2026-10-14); the admission pair (106 stacks) shows none, so the class stays II with this flip stated.
